title: Wildstrubel by UTMB — Wild 110 aid stations and cut-offs (TrailSplits)
claims: TrailSplits lists Wild 110 as 113 km with 6,600 m of gain, a 30-hour limit and 12 aid stations, and says its station services and cut-offs come from the organiser's 2026 page.

TrailSplits gives 2026 cut-offs of Leukerbad 03:15, Kandersteg 08:00, Adelboden 13:15, Lenk 18:30, Iffigenalp 21:00, Tseuzier 02:45 and finish 04:30, one hour earlier than the 2027 official times at the six stations where both publish a time.
TrailSplits' linked GPX URL returned HTTP 404 to a HEAD request on 2026-11-09.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 读取 TrailSplits 页面；其数据自述来自组委会 2026 页，列为 B 层对照，不覆盖 2027 官方值。
